item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents

Mem-Forever: a Git-native persistent memory layer for AI agents
item.description: Every AI tool forgets a user when the session closes. Mem-Forever keeps the memory in the user's own Git repository as compact I-Lang structures that a person can read and a machine can parse, so preferences, decisions and lessons survive across sessions, tools and models. It needs no installation and no configuration: fork the repository and point the agent at it. Documentation in nine languages.

item.title: Open Agent Collaboration Gateway (OACG)
item.description: Open Agent Collaboration Gateway (OACG) v0.1.0 The first public release of OACG, an open-source reference implementation for bounded, auditable collaboration between heterogeneous AI systems. This release begins with OpenAI and xAI/Grok and establishes a provider-independent architecture intended to expand to Claude and additional AI systems. Included in v0.1.0 OpenAI and Grok provider adapters Bounded multi-model collaboration /ask and /collaborate APIs Human approval gates for higher-risk work

item.title: AI Smart Glasses for Wearable Intelligence: From Egocentric Sensing to Agentic Personalization
item.description: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping smart glasses from egocentric capture and display devices into platforms for wearable intelligence. Smart glasses increasingly serve as wearable AI systems that connect first-person observation with real-time assistance under strict form-factor constraints. item.title: Simulation code for "Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum"
item.description: R + targets pipeline reproducing the experiments in the arXiv preprint arXiv:2603.05614, "Real-Time AI Service Economy: A Framework for Agentic Computing Across the Continuum": the topology x load ablation grid, the DSIC strategic-bidding test, a measured agentic LLM workload, and the integrator faithfulness and encapsulation-overhead studies. Reproduce all results with targets::tar_make().
